# @three-ws/render

> Render rigged, animated 3D avatars to PNG, GIF and truecolor terminal ANSI with no GPU, no WebGL and no headless browser. Pure JavaScript software rasterizer for glTF/GLB.

@three-ws/render is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/render`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-render/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-render/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-render/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-render/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
